grades.quote: The result of the floating-point comparison will be written into the condition flag register. When the comparison result is true, it is set to `1` , otherwise it is set to `0` .
grades.reason: LoongArch passage describes where FP comparison results go (fcc0-fcc7, set to 1 if true, else 0). It doesn't explain how FCMP conditions separate ordered from unordered comparisons or NaN handling, so it only gives limited background.
